experiments.title: W3-B -- MAX/lottery-effect phase-0 (A-share AVOID-screen candidate)
experiments.hypothesis: High-MAX names (max single-day return over trailing 21 sessions) underperform in A-shares due to retail lottery preference — a DEFENSIVE screen to exclude top-MAX names from the reversal pool. Primary test: low-MAX minus high-MAX decile CSI300-relative 21d fill-realistic HAC-t. Secondary: screen-test lift (does excluding top-MAX decile lift pool mean?) Universe: board members in china_stocks_raw (1,487 tickers, >=756 rows history), 168 rebalances (2012-05 to 2026-04), mean 882 eligible names. RESULT: NO-GO. L/S t_HAC=-1.118 (fill-real full), -0.605 (pre-2021), -0.982 (post-2021); all below the pre-registered ACCRUE threshold of 2. Screen test lift=0.015%/reb, t=0.52, p=0.606 -- not significant. Perm-p=0.278 (L/S is within null range). CRITICAL FINDING: the relationship is U-SHAPED, not the monotone lottery decay the literature predicts. D1 (low-MAX, stagnant names, max ~1-2%) earns 0.28%/reb -- LOWEST of all deciles. D10 (high-MAX, lottery names) earns 0.78%/reb. Middle deciles D2-D7 earn 0.8-1.2%. Both tails underperform the middle; D1 underperforms more than D10. The RANK-IC IS significant (mean=-0.046, t=-3.985, hit=0.387) -- the ranking relationship exists -- but the economic mechanism is not the expected lottery effect. Positive control fires (reversal t=2.333, instrument alive). Orthogonality: MAX vs reversal cross-corr=-0.384 (partial-IC-MAX survives controlling for rev+abn: t=-3.200), MAX vs abn-turn cross-corr=0.232. MAX is NOT redundant with siblings on partial-IC grounds, but the screen itself is not economically usable. Pre-registered research/china_alpha/w3/china-max-phase0.md + reports/china-max-phase0.md. NOTHING wired.
experiments.come_back_note: CLOSED NO-GO. The D1-D10 L/S spread is not significant (t=-1.12) and the screen lift is negligible and not significant. The U-shaped decile pattern means excluding only the top-MAX decile does not reliably help the pool. Do NOT re-run the simple MAX AVOID screen without a materially different design: (a) run on the full 4,300-name raw panel (not the board-member universe) to reduce potential composition bias; (b) condition MAX on excluding near-stagnant D1 names (the ones dragging the distribution from below are low-vol/illiquid, not lottery); (c) test whether the IC-significant ranking relationship can be exploited differently -- e.g. as an EXCLUSION of both D1 (stagnant) and D10 (lottery), keeping only middle deciles. The rank-IC is real (t=-4.0) and partial-IC survives sibling controls, so the information is present -- the screen just needs a different form.

experiments.hypothesis: Abnormal turnover NEGATIVELY predicts A-share returns (retail overreaction unwinds); the low-abnormal-turnover long leg outperforms -- external evidence +1.24%/mo t=3.35 (2000-2019, EW). T3 monotonicity Spearman(decile#, excess)=+0.079 (flat, not the negative gradient predicted; only D9=highest-abn-turn is weakly lowest). T2 ORTHOGONALITY: residualising abn_turn on the within-sector 3M reversal signal leaves t_HAC=0.72 (mean +0.309%) -- essentially unchanged -> REDUNDANT-WITH-REVERSAL (residual |t|<2). POSITIVE CONTROL fires: the same harness gives reversal high-minus-low +0.638%/reb, t_HAC 1.18, Sharpe 0.33 -> instrument LIVE, so the abn_turn null is a true negative not a dead harness. T6 fill tax: fill-realistic +0.362% vs close-to-close +0.331%/reb (spread-level tax nets out across the two legs). Pre-registered research/china_alpha/w3/W3A_ABNORMAL_TURNOVER.md + reports/china-turnover-phase0.md; unit tests tests/test_china_turnover_phase0.py. NOTHING wired.
experiments.come_back_note: CLOSED NO-GO on a survivorship-clean CSI300-relative substrate with a live positive control. The VOLUME-Z PROXY of abnormal turnover is null (t=0.69), placebo-indistinguishable (perm_p=0.51), sign-unstable across both era splits, and redundant with the reversal factor (residual t=0.72). Do NOT re-run the volume-z construction. Reopen ONLY with a materially different, pre-registered design that clears the same gate (primary |t|>=3 full AND sign-stable both splits AND residual-vs-reversal |t|>=2): (a) a genuine TURNOVER RATIO built from a historical free-float-share series (the float-normalised signal the paper actually tested -- not buildable today, needs new float data), or (b) turnover STABILITY (low variance of turnover) rather than the abnormal-turnover LEVEL, i.e. the Stable-Turnover-Momentum+IVOL daily-cost-survivable variant. The reversal edge (#1) remains the one validated selection signal; abn_turn does not add to it. experiments.name: Setup Species S14 — Failed breakout (trapped-buyer supply)
experiments.what: A new-high breakout that closes back below the breakout level traps late buyers who chased the print; their supply overhang suppresses subsequent rally attempts. The failed-breakout pattern identifies names whose breakout has reversed intrabar or within 1-3 sessions, leaving the majority of late entrants underwater. This is a top/entry-veto-shaped context for de-escalation or new-position avoidance — NOT a short-selling signal. The supply overhang typically resolves as: (a) time washout (late buyers capitulate) or (b) re-test of the breakout level on improved breadth. Mechanism link: the Wave-5 retest_hold study confirmed that a retest of the prior high WITHOUT breakout failure predicts continuation; the complement (WITH failure) predicts elevated drawdown risk.
